domain: Arithmetic with rational numbers (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed numbers to improper fractions
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number as an equivalent improper fraction by converting the whole part into fractional units and combining with the fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly converts a mixed number (e.g., 3 1/2) into an improper fraction (e.g., 7/2)
A step rewrites a nonstandard mixed form like 2 3/2 as 2 + 3/2 and then as an improper fraction
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting a whole number as a fraction with a specified denominator (use S02)
Only converting an improper fraction to a mixed number/whole number (use S06)

skills.name: Rewrite whole numbers as equivalent fractions with a specified denominator
skills.definition: Express an integer as an equivalent fraction with a target denominator (often to match another denominator for subtraction).
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites an integer as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 2 = 6/3, 4 = 12/3, 2 = 16/8)
The denominator is chosen to match or become the common denominator for subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Converting a mixed number to an improper fraction (use S01)
Finding an LCM/common denominator between two non-integer fractions (use S03)

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator (create equivalent fractions)
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step identifies a common denominator/LCM for two denominators
A step scales numerators/denominators to rewrite fractions with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the step only subtracts numerators (use S04)
Only rewriting an integer as a fraction with a specified denominator (use S02)
Only simplifying the result after subtraction (use S05)

skills.name: Subtract fractions once denominators match
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator (including cases that yield 0 or a whole number like 8/8).
inclusion_criteria: A step performs subtraction of fractions with a common denominator, a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b
A step subtracts identical fractions to get 0 or produces an equivalent whole-number fraction (e.g., 8/8) as the subtraction result
exclusion_criteria: A step is primarily about creating equivalent fractions/common denominators (use S03)
A step is primarily about rewriting an integer as a fraction (use S02)
A step is primarily about reducing/simplifying the result (use S05)
A step subtracts mixed numbers by separating whole and fractional parts (use S07)

skills.name: Simplify/reduce fractions to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor and/or recognize when a fraction is already in lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: A step states the fraction is already in lowest terms
exclusion_criteria: Only converting between mixed and improper forms (use S01 or S06)
Only performing the subtraction operation (use S04 or S07)

skills.name: Convert improper fractions to mixed numbers or whole numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite an improper fraction as a mixed number or integer by division (quotient and remainder), including recognizing a/a = 1 and 0 as an integer result.
inclusion_criteria: A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (e.g., 7/4 = 1 3/4, 5/3 = 1 2/3)
A step converts a fraction equal to 1 (e.g., 8/8) into the integer 1, or reports 0 as an integer
exclusion_criteria: Converting mixed numbers to improper fractions (use S01)
Only reducing a fraction without changing representation (use S05)

skills.name: Subtract mixed numbers by separating whole and fractional parts
skills.definition: Compute a mixed-number difference by subtracting whole-number parts and fractional parts separately (including handling a negative fractional difference) and recombining.
inclusion_criteria: A step decomposes mixed numbers into (whole difference) + (fraction difference), e.g., (4−2) + (4/12−7/12)
A step recombines the whole and fractional results into a single value (mixed number or improper fraction)
exclusion_criteria: Method converts mixed numbers to improper fractions and then subtracts as fractions (use S01 + S04)
Only converting an improper fraction to a mixed number at the end (use S06)
